comment: The static cost function assigns one constant per straight-line region of the post-normalization canonical program. A region's constant counts its expression nodes and static-data value nodes (object keys count nothing). Invocation, branch, lazy, and builtin-call boundary nodes belong to no region; their charges arrive as events or as entry into the region they select. See docs/runtime/execution-limits.md.

cases.description: constant array program is one region counting the array node and its items
builtin call node is a boundary; its literal arguments form the entry region
function literal counts 1 where it is created; each $if arm is its own region
cases.comment: The body entry region counts the condition's $var and literal; the gt call and the $if node are boundaries.

cases.description: each $let binding expression is its own region behind the lazy boundary
cases.comment: The body entry region counts the $let node and the two $var reads in $in; the binding region counts its $var and literal.

cases.description: $raw payload counts one per value node
cases.comment: Object 1 + grid array 1 + two row arrays 2 + four scalars 4 = 8. The $raw wrapper adds nothing.

cases.description: the equivalent plain constant data derives the same constant
